hints.text: 'Crustless' and 'half' are our indicators — one tells us to remove the outer letters of a word, and the other tells us to take just half of something.
Our fodder is 'Flat' and 'size' — we’ll be using these letters as the indicators instruct.
The definition is 'loaf' — and our answer will be a synonym of this. But if you're only thinking of bread, you won't get far!
